TomTom Executive Extols Virtues of Traffic Data in ULEZ Health Debate

August 22, 2026 Highways News TomTom, ULEZ, London, air pollution, traffic data, public health, children's lung growth, Ultra Low Emission Zone
Read the source article

Quick summary

A TomTom executive highlighted the role of traffic data in the ULEZ health debate, pointing to a study showing that children whose lung growth had been stunted by air pollution showed a striking recovery after the implementation of London's Ultra Low Emission Zone.

Key takeaways

  • London's ULEZ linked to rapid recovery in children's lung growth according to a new study
  • TomTom's traffic data provides evidence for the public health impact of urban emission zones
  • Children whose lung growth had been stunted by air pollution showed measurable improvement
  • The debate highlights the intersection of traffic data, public health policy, and urban air quality management
  • TomTom positions its traffic data as a tool for evidence-based urban policy beyond navigation
